title: AxiomMath verifies the Stacks Project to keep AI slop out of math
teaser: AxiomMath has formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the largest mathematics libraries built by humans. The company’s AI agents converted about 7,654 pages into 16 million lines of Lean code, which a proof assistant checks line by line. The $1.6 billion startup expects this verified mathematical foundation to help agents write reliable software and, eventually, do science. The project brings together results ranging from university algebra to advanced ideas in algebra, geometry and number theory.
